description:
Title: OEE

Write a process, that collects relevant information from a machine, and calculated the Overall Equipment Efficiency (OEE).
If the OEE falls below a certain value/percentage, stop the machine and send an email to an engineer.
When the machine is restarted, continue measuring.
When the machine is disconnected, stop the process.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_OEE"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/oee">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineInformation" name="Machine information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StopCommand" name="Stop command"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OEEAlertEmail" name="OEE alert email"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OEE">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OEEProcess" name="OEE process" processRef="Process_OEE"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Machine" name="Machine"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Engineer" name="Engineer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MachineInformation" name="Machine information" sourceRef="Participant_Machine" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMachineInformation" messageRef="Message_MachineInformation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StopCommand" name="Stop command" sourceRef="Task_StopMachine" targetRef="Participant_Machine" messageRef="Message_StopCommand"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted" sourceRef="Participant_Machine" targetRef="Task_WaitForRestart" messageRef="Message_MachineRestarted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected" sourceRef="Participant_Machine" targetRef="Start_MachineDisconnected" messageRef="Message_MachineDisconnected"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OEEAlertEmail" name="OEE alert email" sourceRef="Task_EmailEngineer" targetRef="Participant_Engineer" messageRef="Message_OEEAlertEmail"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OEE" name="OEE" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OEE" name="Start measuring"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveMachineInformation" name="Collect machine information" messageRef="Message_MachineInformation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CalculateOEE" name="Calculate OEE"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OEEThreshold" name="Is OEE below the threshold?" default="Flow_OEEThresholdNotBelow"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_StopMachine" name="Stop machine" messageRef="Message_StopCommand"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmailEngineer" name="Send email to engineer" messageRef="Message_OEEAlertEmail"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_WaitForRestart" name="Wait for machine to restart" messageRef="Message_MachineRestarted"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_MachineDisconnected" name="Stop process when machine disconnects" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected" isInterrupting="true">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_MachineDisconnected" messageRef="Message_MachineDisconnected"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ProcessStopped" name="Process stopped">
        <bpmn:terminateEventDefinition id="TerminateEventDefinition_ProcessStopped"/>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DisconnectedToStopped" sourceRef="Start_MachineDisconnected" targetRef="End_ProcessStopped"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToCollect" sourceRef="Start_OEE" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMachineInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectToCalculate" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveMachineInformation" targetRef="Task_CalculateOEE"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CalculateToThreshold" sourceRef="Task_CalculateOEE" targetRef="Gateway_OEEThreshold"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OEEThresholdBelow" name="Below threshold" sourceRef="Gateway_OEEThreshold" targetRef="Task_StopMachine">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">OEE < threshold</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OEEThresholdNotBelow" name="Not below threshold" sourceRef="Gateway_OEEThreshold" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMachineInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StopToEmail" sourceRef="Task_StopMachine" targetRef="Task_EmailEngineer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmailToRestart" sourceRef="Task_EmailEngineer" targetRef="Task_WaitForRestart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RestartToCollect" sourceRef="Task_WaitForRestart" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMachineInformation"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
